Description

Product ID: 485655

  • 100% premium linen with a unique texture and elegant sheen.

  • Our men’s Premium Linen Shirt is designed as a versatile warm‑weather staple with a clean, refined look that works across casual and more polished settings. Made from 100% linen, the fabric offers a naturally crisp feel, while a hand‑selection process removes non‑uniform linen fibers to create a smoother, more even surface. The regular fit and balanced proportions allow the shirt to be worn tucked in for a sharper appearance or untucked for relaxed styling, making it easy to pair with straight‑leg pants, chinos, denim, or lightweight layering pieces during spring and summer.

    - 100% linen fabric delivers a lightweight feel suited for warm to mild weather.
    - Hand‑selected linen fibers help create a smoother surface while preserving the natural character of linen.
    - Regular fit provides a clean silhouette that works for everyday wear without feeling restrictive.
    - Designed to style neatly tucked in or untucked, offering flexible outfit options.
    - Not sheer overall; only the White color may appear slightly sheer depending on light and layering.
    - Clean lines and a crisp feel make it easy to dress up with tailored bottoms or dress down with relaxed pants or shorts.
    - Works well on its own in warm conditions or layered under light outerwear in transitional weather.
    - Compared with linen‑blend shirts, pure linen offers a more defined texture and a crisper look, while remaining comfortable and easy to wear.

    Function details

    - Sheer: Not Sheer(Only 00 White is slightly sheer)
    - Fit: Regular

  • Fabric details

    100% Linen

    Imported

    RN: 139864

    Washing instructions

    Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, Dry clean

    Recommendations for care:
    When using a washing machine, select a cold temperature setting and cycle with lowest spin. No Tumbler/Dryer.
    Remove your linen quickly from washer.
    Adjust it to cut down wrinkles by hand.
    Hang it to dry in the shade using a hanger. Avoid direct sunlight.

  • Production

    Production: Bangladesh

    Our brand is continuously working to improve our understanding of the production process in our supply chain and to verify this information both in-house and with third parties. By having full understanding of the origins of raw materials, and the locations of the spinning, material production, sewing, knitting, and assembly processes, we are improving quality of our clothing and at the same time aiming to thoroughly ensure safe and secure manufacturing. We will continue to post information for customers to access and learn more about their clothing.

    *The information on material production locations applies to products manufactured after 24FW.
